content: Incident: Database Connection Pool Exhaustion. Severity: CRITICAL. Client: client_alpha. Environment: prod. Region: us-east-1. Resource: rds-postgres-alpha-001. alert_title: S3 Bucket Request Rate Throttling - s3-delta-012
content: Post-incident review for INC-1279: S3 Bucket Request Rate Throttling (MEDIUM) at client_delta, environment prod, region us-east-1, resource s3-delta-012. Detection time: 2026-02-04T18:46:00+00:00. Detection evidence: CloudWatch request metrics showed elevated 503 SlowDown responses during a parallel object read workload. Impact: the affected workload experienced a service degradation until the mitigation was verified; unrelated client environments were not implicated. Root cause: A newly introduced worker fan-out exceeded the tested request rate for a concentrated object-key prefix. Response: Reduced worker concurrency, added bounded exponential backoff with jitter to the reader, and divided the workload into controlled batches. No objects were modified during diagnosis. Recovery evidence: Request error metrics returned to baseline and sampled object checksums matched the source manifest. Preventive actions: retain an alert on the leading indicator, test the recovery procedure in a non-production environment, and require service-owner review for changes to the relevant capacity, access, or retry boundary. Resolution recorded: Throttling cleared after limiting read concurrency and adding bounded retries to the object-processing workers.
resolution_summary: Throttling cleared after limiting read concurrency and adding bounded retries to the object-processing workers.

content: Architecture guidance informed by incident INC-1280: Lambda Invocation Throttling (HIGH) affecting client_epsilon, environment prod, region us-east-1, resource lambda-epsilon-012; observed 2026-02-04T21:03:00+00:00. Operational signal: Lambda throttles increased while the asynchronous event queue age rose above the service objective. Design controls: keep capacity and retry limits explicit; scope IAM and resource policies to the service identity; distribute critical capacity across approved availability zones; retain actionable CloudWatch metrics and logs; and exercise recovery steps before production rollout. Incident outcome: Rate-limited the backfill and adjusted its schedule to preserve concurrency for normal event traffic.
resolution_summary: Rate-limited the backfill and adjusted its schedule to preserve concurrency for normal event traffic.

alert_title: Auto Scaling Group Capacity Shortfall - autoscaling-epsilon-040
content: Architecture guidance informed by incident INC-2000: Auto Scaling Group Capacity Shortfall (HIGH) affecting client_epsilon, environment production, region ca-central-1, resource autoscaling-epsilon-040; observed 2026-05-05T21:03:00+00:00. Operational signal: The group remained below desired capacity and launched instances failed to become healthy targets. Failure mechanism: A launch template revision selected a subnet with insufficient available addresses. Resilience pattern: Compared launch failures across subnets, rolled back the faulty template revision, and restored capacity in approved subnets with verified address headroom. Acceptance checks: The group reached desired capacity and all new instances passed status checks and target health probes. Design controls: keep capacity and retry limits explicit; scope IAM and resource policies to the service identity; distribute critical capacity across approved availability zones; retain actionable CloudWatch metrics and logs; and exercise recovery steps before production rollout. Incident outcome: Reverted the subnet selection change and restored capacity in subnets with verified address headroom.
